canonicalSchema.string: JSON double-quoted; escape quotation mark, reverse-solidus and U+0000..U+001F; preserve all other Unicode scalar UTF-8 bytes; lone surrogate forbidden
canonicalSchema.integer: base-10; range -9007199254740991..9007199254740991; no plus sign; no leading zero except zero; negative zero forbidden
canonicalSchema.object: keys unique by raw Unicode scalar sequence; order unsigned UTF-8 byte lexicographic ascending
canonicalSchema.array: order significant; no implicit set semantics
canonicalSchema.set: represented as array sorted by member canonical bytes; duplicates forbidden; schema must declare Set<T>
canonicalSchema.collectionConstructor: SHA-256(domain UTF-8 || 0x00 || uint32be(count) || repeated(uint32be(recordByteLength)||canonicalRecordBytes)); records sorted by declared key unsigned UTF-8 bytes

declaredTypes.Set<T>: canonical-byte sorted unique array of declared T
declaredTypes.Receipt: closed object conforming to named receipt schema
declaredTypes.TimestampUtc: RFC3339 UTC second precision YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; trusted-time receipt required
declaredTypes.PredicateAst: closed discriminated object defined by semanticProgramSchema

grammar.byteProfile: UTF-8; BOM-FORBIDDEN; CR-FORBIDDEN; LF=0x0A; NO-UNICODE-NORMALIZATION; BIDI-BYTES-PRESERVED
lexicalRules: HEADING = (H2 / H3) *UTF8-SCALAR BACKTICK ID BACKTICK *UTF8-SCALAR LF
COLON_FIELD = BACKTICK LABEL BACKTICK %x3A *SP BACKTICK BACKTICK_VALUE BACKTICK
TABLE_ROW = %x7C SP 1*(TABLE_CELL %x7C); TABLE_CELL preserves decoded bytes after outer SP and one optional outer BACKTICK pair

resultRules.occurrenceOrder: artifactAlias UTF-8 bytes, sourceLine UInt ascending, sourceByteStart0 ascending, fieldName UTF-8 bytes
resultRules.disposition: zero occurrences=MISSING; one distinct raw byte value=PRESENT; more than one distinct raw byte value=CONFLICT
resultRules.canonicalValue: PRESENT returns sole raw UTF-8 value; otherwise Null

semanticProgramSchema.operatorSemantics: Each operator is a closed assertion over the named exact registry field(s); unknown operator/argument/additional field blocks
semanticProgramSchema.passRule: ALL assertion results true AND exact five expected immutable vector receipt roots present AND both readbacks equal current invalidation snapshot

reviewOperations.atomicRule: CAS EMPTY generation head to one immutable sealed generation; no overwrite; one reviewer/controller root cannot occupy both generations
CAS EMPTY reconciliation head to exactly one immutable lossless union; P0/P1 cannot risk-accept; P2/P3 require explicit accepted Protocol authority; missing/conflict stays open veto
CAS EMPTY acceptance head to one complete immutable envelope or commit zero durable members; consume one-use authority in same transaction; no self-approval

terminalAcceptanceCriteria.convergence: A fresh hostile review that produces zero new P0/P1 and validly dispositions every P2/P3 may terminate in reconciliation and Acceptance; no recursive successor is required merely to prove absence of hypothetical future findings
